# Lengdon

> The closing infrastructure for private capital fundraising — a deal room,
> a diligence checklist, and a term sheet that all point to the same
> reference number, entirely in-platform.

Built by Venture Tech LLC, DIFC FinTech Hive, Dubai, UAE.

## What it does

- Private NDA-gated deal rooms: document sharing, structured due diligence,
  AI document analysis, Q&A.
- Every disclosure Lengdon publishes is built against a public evidence
  standard — Preferred, Alternative, or Minimum evidence per field. No
  verification score, no percentage: the standard states what backs a
  claim, not whether it's true.
- Per-term negotiation across four instrument types (SAFE, Equity, Debt,
  Company Sale) with a full audit trail.
- A six-gate closing sequence — Counsel, Agreement, Conditions, Signing,
  Payment, Close — enforced in order: a room cannot advance to the next
  gate until the current one is confirmed. Investor and founder each
  confirm the payment step independently; mutual confirmation at Close
  seals a permanent record that stays accessible to both parties. Lengdon
  records the transfer confirmation — it does not move money itself.

## Fee model

Free during beta. After beta, pricing is fee-by-event rather than a flat
subscription — a one-time fee at first close, or a monthly fee while a raise
is active. Full current tiers: https://lengdon.com/product/pricing. A 1.5%
success fee applies on closed deals (minimum $500, maximum $15,000), charged
only at closing. No fee if a deal doesn't close.

## Key pages

- [Homepage](https://lengdon.com/): the six-gate sequence, the append-only
  record, and who the product is built for.
- [Pricing](https://lengdon.com/product/pricing): full pricing detail.
- [About](https://lengdon.com/company/about): company origin and entity detail.
- [Docs](https://lengdon.com/docs): full product documentation for
  founders, investors, deal rooms, and the AI features.
- [Blog](https://lengdon.com/blog): fundraising and deal-flow articles.
- [Free calculators](https://lengdon.com/tools): valuation, burn rate,
  runway, COGS, cap table, SAFE note, and dilution calculators — no signup
  required.

## Docs

Full documentation lives at https://lengdon.com/docs, organized by
founder features, investor features, deal rooms, and AI. The security model
and platform changelog are at /docs/security and /docs/changelog.
